name: Commit
meaning: The exact commit the suites ran against.

name: Provider
meaning: The CI system that ran them.

name: Run reference
meaning: The provider's identity for the run and attempt.

name: Started at
meaning: When the run started.

name: Finished at
meaning: When the run finished.

name: Spec digest
meaning: The digest of the spec's data files at the commit, so the outcome list is tied to the test records it answers.

name: Attestation
meaning: Where the signed proof run is kept.

name: Test record
meaning: The ID of the test record in the spec.

name: Result
meaning: What the test did.

name: File
meaning: The file that ran it, from the product root.

name: Duration
meaning: How long it ran, in seconds.

name: Detail
meaning: Why it failed or was skipped, when it did not pass.

name: Commit
meaning: The commit the gate decided on.

name: Kind
meaning: Which gate.

name: Base commit
meaning: The base branch's head the change was gated against; none for a release.

name: Coverage
meaning: The coverage at the commit.

name: Base coverage
meaning: The coverage at the base commit; none for a release.

name: Proof run
meaning: The attestation of the proof run the decision rests on.

name: Passed
meaning: Whether the commit passed the gate.

name: Reasons
meaning: Each reason for a refusal, one per line; empty when passed.
example:
ST-BLD-UC03-R01 fell from built
ST-GEN-INV05-T failed

name: Attestation
meaning: Where the signed decision is kept; a passed release decision always has one, and a refused decision or a change decision has none.

name: Code faults
meaning: Each code-standard fault in the commit's tree, with its file or package, the rule it breaks, and whether the base branch's head has it; a change is refused for a new fault, a release for any.
example: internal/compiler/lock.go: no record (ST-STD-CODE-R05), present at base

name: Retirements
meaning: Each retirement the change gate followed, with the retired obligation and its successor; none for a release.
example: retirement ST-BLD-RT01: ST-BLD-UC06-R02 succeeded by ST-BLD-UC07-R01

name: Module file digest
meaning: The digest of go.mod.

name: Sum file digest
meaning: The digest of go.sum.

name: Go version
meaning: The Go version go.mod states.

name: Source revision
meaning: The commit the cache serves.

name: Go SDK
meaning: The SDK that downloaded it.

name: Inventory digest
meaning: The digest of the cache's canonical record.

name: Module path
meaning: The module.

name: Version
meaning: Its version.

name: Zip hash
meaning: The hash go.sum states for its zip.

name: Source revision
meaning: The commit built.

name: Target
meaning: The entry point built, within the module.

name: Go SDK
meaning: The SDK that built it.

name: Module cache digest
meaning: The inventory of the module cache it built from.

name: Generation record digest
meaning: The digest of the service's .stego/state.yaml at that revision.

name: Executable digest
meaning: The digest of the executable it produced.

name: Record digest
meaning: The digest of the build record's canonical bytes.

name: Format
meaning: Its format.

name: Digest
meaning: The digest of the SBOM file.

name: Build record digest
meaning: The trusted build record the executable came from.

name: Executable digest
meaning: The executable it carries.

name: CA bundle digest
meaning: The explicit CA bundle it carries.

name: Entrypoint
meaning: The executable's name in the image.

name: Image digest
meaning: The OCI image's digest.

name: Signer
meaning: Who signed.

name: Transparency log entry
meaning: The signature's entry in the public transparency log.

name: Signed at
meaning: When it was signed.

name: Repository
meaning: The registry repository, without a tag.

name: Published at
meaning: When it was published.

name: Service name
meaning: The service the declaration describes.

name: Archetype
meaning: The curated component set the service is built from. Exactly one.

name: Language
meaning: The language the output is generated in.

name: Base path
meaning: The prefix every generated route sits under.

name: Error type base
meaning: The base address the generated error types are named from.

name: Declaration version
meaning: The declaration version the file is written in. Checking refuses a version the registry does not accept, and names the versions it accepts.

name: Modes
meaning: The modes the service runs: api, worker, controller. Omitted means all. all is allowed in production.

name: Mixins
meaning: The mixins bound into the service. kafka-events requires durable-events. event-publisher is a deprecated alias that resolves to durable-events plus kafka-events (ST-SUP-INV17).

name: Entity name
meaning: The shape's name, unique in the declaration.

name: Tenant
meaning: owned, shared or system. owned gets the tenant column, the key prefix and the RLS policy. shared is readable by all tenants and writable only by system. system has no tenant and is never exposed through a tenant request. Omitted means owned.

name: Audit
meaning: on or off. Omitted means on.

name: Kind
meaning: data or ledger. Omitted means data. A ledger entity carries Ledger settings and Ledger account rows.

name: Resource type
meaning: The type of the entity in the authorization schema, when the service binds authorization.

name: Permissions
meaning: The permission checked per operation, as operation: permission, or public with a reason. When authorization is bound, every operation of every collection over the entity must map, and an operation left out is refused, never unprotected. Every permission named must exist in the schema.
example: read: view, update: edit, delete: edit

name: Expected cardinality
meaning: small or large. small lists through resource search; large lists through batch evaluation over database pages.

name: Context fields
meaning: The request fields passed to caveats. Each one must be a caveat parameter in the schema.

name: Public reasons
meaning: The reason for each operation declared public, one per operation, required for it; the fleet lists every public operation with its reason.
example: list: the catalog is public by design, ticket CAT-12

name: Field name
meaning: The field's name, unique in its entity.

name: Type
meaning: The kind of value the field holds.

name: Constraints
meaning: The limits the generated code checks, which must suit the type.

name: Default
meaning: The value used when the field is absent.

name: Sensitivity
meaning: public, pii or secret. pii is redacted before the audit hash. secret is never stored. An entity with any pii field has its reads audited at every level.

name: Collection name
meaning: The access pattern's name, unique in the declaration.

name: Entity name
meaning: The entity the collection reads, which the same declaration must declare.

name: Operations
meaning: What the collection allows. Each one generates its own handler and route.

name: Path prefix
meaning: The path the collection is served at, when it is not derived from the entity name and the scope.

name: Collection name
meaning: The collection the binding applies to. A binding names a collection, never an entity.

name: Slot
meaning: The extension point, which a component of the selected archetype must declare.

name: Operator
meaning: How the fills compose. Exactly one of gate, chain or fan-out.

name: Fills
meaning: The fills the operator composes, in order.

name: Runs as
meaning: tenant or system: the principal the fills run as. Omitted means tenant.

name: Audit annotations
meaning: A string map the fills add to the audit record of the operation.

name: Relationships written
meaning: The relations, as resource_type#relation, that a fill bound to this slot may write. The generated slot handle exposes only those. Checking compiles them against the schema and refuses one the schema lacks.

name: Component name
meaning: The component the setting is for, which must be in the active component set.

name: Setting name
meaning: The setting, which the component's schema must declare.

name: Value
meaning: The value, which must suit the type the component's schema states.

name: Component name
meaning: The component the service accepts, whose stage is not ga.

name: Accepted until
meaning: The date the acceptance runs out, which may not be later than the component's own sunset. The acceptance holds to the end of this date in UTC.

name: Reason
meaning: Why the service accepts it, so a reader can judge the risk.

name: Module path
meaning: The Go module path fills may import.

name: Reason
meaning: Why the fills need it, so a reviewer can judge it.

name: Kind
meaning: single or pooled. pooled gives every owned entity a tenant column, a key prefix and a row-level security policy. single serves one organisation and needs a reason.

name: Key
meaning: The field that holds the tenant identifier.

name: Claim
meaning: The path of the claim in the verified identity token that the tenant comes from: a token claim path, which is one or more claim names joined by dots, each a non-empty run of letters, digits, underscores, hyphens, colons or slashes. Never a request part: checking refuses a claim whose first name is header, headers, body, request, query, path or cookie, in any letter case.

name: Reason
meaning: Why the service leaves the default. Required when the kind is single. The fleet shows it.

name: Sink
meaning: The port binding the audit records are copied to through the outbox. The platform binds the port.

name: Retention
meaning: How long the local audit partitions are kept.

name: Level
meaning: metadata or change. metadata omits the before and after state. change is the default. A read of an entity with a pii field is audited at every level.

name: Enabled
meaning: Whether audit is on. off needs a reason, and the fleet shows it.

name: Reason
meaning: Why audit is off. Required when audit is off.
example: Stateless proxy with no data of its own

name: PII
meaning: redact or keep, written audit.pii. With either value an audit row never holds personal data: it holds each field declared pii as the redaction marker, and its hash is over that redacted record. keep states that the service's source record keeps the field, so the fleet can name each service that keeps pii; an erasure changes only the source row, never an audit row.

name: Provider
meaning: The provider of the decision and relationship ports. spicedb first. A provider that cannot search is allowed; its lists use batch evaluation.

name: Schema path
meaning: The path of the .zed schema in the service repository. Checking compiles it and refuses a name the declaration uses that the schema lacks.

name: Subject from identity
meaning: The identity field a request subject is made from. A system principal is a service-account subject, never a bypass.

name: System subject type
meaning: The subject type of the schema that a system principal acts as. Required when a binding runs as system; checking refuses a type that the schema does not define or grants no relation to.

name: Relation
meaning: The relation in the schema, under the resource type of the entity.

name: Subject source
meaning: field or caller: where the subject identifier comes from.

name: Subject field
meaning: The field the subject identifier comes from, when the source is field.

name: Subject type
meaning: The schema type of the subject.

name: Required on
meaning: The operations a request must carry a key for. create is always one of them. Only operations served by POST or PATCH may be named, such as patch; read and list (GET), update (PUT) and delete (DELETE) ignore the key and are refused.

name: Retention
meaning: How long a key and its stored response are kept. 24h is the default.

name: Fingerprint
meaning: What the fingerprint covers besides the method and the path: body, body+query or none.

name: Currency
meaning: The ISO 4217 code of the ledger. One per ledger; a cross-currency move is two transfers through a conversion account.

name: Transfer codes
meaning: The transfer codes the ledger accepts, emitted as a check constraint.

name: Two phase
meaning: Whether a transfer may be pended and then posted or voided.

name: Pending timeout
meaning: How long a pending transfer may stay pending before it expires.

name: Snapshot every
meaning: The entries per account between balance snapshots.

name: Account name
meaning: The name of the account, unique in its ledger.

name: Normal
meaning: debit or credit: the side the account grows on.

name: Minimum balance
meaning: The lowest balance the account may reach, in the currency of the ledger.

name: Owner
meaning: The entity that owns an account of this kind, when one does.

name: Hot
meaning: yes when the account is never row-locked, such as a settlement account.

name: Controller name
meaning: The name of the controller, unique in the declaration.

name: Sources
meaning: scan, watch or both: how the controller learns of work.

name: Resync
meaning: How often the controller reconciles everything again.

name: Replicas
meaning: The replicas that stand by under lease election.

name: Lease TTL
meaning: How long a lease holds before another replica may claim it.

name: Tenants
meaning: each: the controller iterates tenants and opens one transaction per tenant. none is refused.

name: Invariant name
meaning: The name of the rule, unique in the declaration.

name: Kind
meaning: unique, no_overlap or sum_limit. unique emits a unique index, no_overlap an exclusion constraint, sum_limit a constraint trigger that locks the parent row.

name: On
meaning: The entity, or entity.field, the rule holds for.

name: Where
meaning: The condition that selects the rows the rule holds for.

name: By
meaning: The fields that scope the rule, for unique and no_overlap.

name: Range
meaning: The two fields that bound the range, for no_overlap.

name: Parent
meaning: The parent entity.field that holds the limit, for sum_limit.

name: Command name
meaning: The command's name, unique in the declaration.

name: Writes
meaning: The entities the command may read and write, which the same declaration must declare. The command handle reaches only these.

name: Resource type
meaning: The type in the authorization schema that the command acts on, when the service binds authorization.

name: Permission
meaning: The permission the caller needs on the resource before the fill runs. When authorization is bound, it is required.

name: Fill
meaning: The one fill that carries out the command at the command slot.

name: Relationships written
meaning: The relations, as resource_type#relation, that the fill may write through its command handle. The handle exposes only those.

name: Effects
meaning: The effects the fill may stage through its command handle, each as an outbox destination and an effect name; the effect name is part of each outgoing idempotency key. The destinations authz and audit are not effects: a relationship tuple goes only through the authorization handle, and an audit row only through the audit runtime.

name: Resource member
meaning: The request member that holds the ID of the resource the permission is decided on. For a command that creates a resource, it holds the ID of the parent the new resource goes under, and the resource type and the permission are the parent's. When authorization is bound, it is required.

name: Route
meaning: The method and path the command is served at, always with POST. The route is part of the idempotency fingerprint, and it must not conflict with another route of the service.

name: Refusals
meaning: The refusals that the fill may return, each as name: status code, with a name in lower snake case, an HTTP status of 400, 403, 404, 409, 412 or 422, and a fixed code. The fill returns one by name through a generated typed value; the handler answers it with its status and code, and any other error with 500 and the code internal.

name: Method
meaning: The unary protobuf method, as package.Service/Method, that serves the command when the service has the grpc-application component. The generated gRPC handler calls the same fill with the same handle as the HTTP route.

name: Retry on conflict
meaning: How many times the handler runs the fill again, each time in a new transaction, when a version-checked write or a locked read meets a conflict, before it answers 409 with the code conflict. 0, the default, runs the fill once; at most 3.

name: Query name
meaning: The query's name, unique in the declaration.

name: Reads
meaning: The entities the query may read, which the same declaration must declare. The query handle reaches only these.

name: Resource type
meaning: The type in the authorization schema that the query acts on, when the service binds authorization.

name: Permission
meaning: The permission the caller needs on the resource before the fill runs. When authorization is bound, it is required.

name: Fill
meaning: The one fill that carries out the query at the query slot.

name: Resource member
meaning: The request member that holds the ID of the one resource the query is decided on. A list query names none: it is decided row by row as it reads.

name: Route
meaning: The method and path the query is served at, always with GET. It must not conflict with another route of the service.

name: Refusals
meaning: The refusals that the fill may return, each as name: status code, with a name in lower snake case, an HTTP status of 400, 403, 404, 409, 412 or 422, and a fixed code. The fill returns one by name through a generated typed value; the handler answers it with its status and code, and any other error with 500 and the code internal.

name: Method
meaning: The protobuf method, as package.Service/Method, that serves the query when the service has the grpc-application component: a unary method, or a server stream whose fill sends each result as one message. The generated gRPC handler calls the same fill with the same read-only handle as the HTTP route.

name: Observation name
meaning: The observation's name, in lower snake case and unique in the declaration. Each signal carries it as domain.<name>, so it cannot be the same as a name that the telemetry runtime sets.

name: Kind
meaning: event, counter or histogram. An event becomes a log record and an event on the current span; a counter adds one for each emission; a histogram records one number for each emission.

name: Severity
meaning: debug, info, warn or error: the severity of the log record of an event, and of the local console line of each kind.

name: Fields
meaning: The values that each emission carries, in order, as name: type. A type is a field of a declared entity as Entity.field, which the probe method reads itself from a loaded value of that entity, so the fill cannot pass other text; an enum with its values as enum(a | b); bool; or a measure with a unit and a range of integers as measure(unit, min..max), with the unit s, ms, By or 1. Free text and a plain int are not types. The probe method takes the loaded entity values first, then the other fields in this order.
example: sku: Reservation.sku, reason: enum(short | expired), qty: measure(1, 1..1000)

name: Value
meaning: For a histogram only: the number that each emission records, as name: unit, with the unit s, ms, By or 1. The probe method takes it as its last parameter.

name: Emitted by
meaning: The commands, queries, workers and process methods by name, and the slot bindings as collection.slot, whose fills may emit the observation. Only the probe of each of them has the observation's method.

name: Outcome measured
meaning: The ID of the service's own business outcome whose measure counts this observation, when it has one. STEGO shows it with the observation and does not check it, because the service's outcomes are not part of the declaration.

name: Counts
meaning: When an emission is sent: attempt or committed. attempt, the default, sends it when the call ends with the attribute stego.outcome set to committed or rolled_back, so a refusal that rolls back is still seen; committed sends it only after a commit and drops it at a rollback, for counts of work done. An observation with an outcome measured must state it.

name: Change ID
meaning: The change's name, in lower kebab case and unique in the declaration. It names the change's migrations, the lease of its backfill as stego.backfill.<change ID> and its checkpoint. No other change can use it again.

name: Kind
meaning: add, rename, retype, require, drop or unique. add puts a new entity, or a new field that is optional or has a default, into the stored shape; rename gives a field a new name in storage and in the generated code; retype gives a field a new type; require adds a required field with no default; drop removes a field or an entity; unique adds a declared invariant of kind unique to an entity.

name: Entity
meaning: The entity whose table the change changes. For add with no field it is a new entity whose table the change makes; for drop with no field it is an entity that the declaration no longer declares, whose table the change removes.

name: Field
meaning: The field that the change is about, by its name after the change: the new name for rename, the field with its new type for retype, and the new field for add and require. For drop it is the field that goes, which the entity no longer declares; for unique it is the name of the declared invariant of kind unique.

name: From
meaning: For rename, the field's name before the change; for retype, the field's type before the change. No other kind has it.

name: Conversion
meaning: For retype only: the name of the conversion from the old type to the new one, from the set that the database component declares, such as text_to_integer. Free SQL is not accepted.

name: Inverse conversion
meaning: For retype only: the name of the conversion from the new type back to the old one, from the same set, which keeps the old column right for the old release while both releases run.

name: Fill value
meaning: For require: the value that each row that exists gets. For retype: the value that the backfill gives a row whose old value does not convert; the author can add it in a later release, after the backfill reports failed rows. For drop: the default that the old column gets at expand, else the zero value of the type. It must suit the field's type and constraints.

name: Definition
meaning: For drop only: the removed field's type, constraints and default, or the removed entity's fields, as the entity declared them, so that the baseline and the contract come from the declaration alone.

name: Change ID
meaning: The schema change that the step moves.

name: Phase
meaning: expand or contract. expand adds what the old and the new release both need and starts the backfill; contract removes what only the old release needed. A change of kind add has an expand step only.

name: Worker name
meaning: The worker's name, in lower kebab case and unique among the commands, queries, workers and controllers of the declaration. The worker's principal is service_account:<name>.

name: Trigger
meaning: When the worker runs: every <interval>, from 10s to 24h, to run once for each tenant at each tick; or consumes <destination>, to run once for each message that a command or another worker stages to that outbox destination of the service.

name: Writes
meaning: The entities the worker may read and write, which the same declaration must declare. The worker handle reaches only these.

name: Resource type
meaning: The type in the authorization schema that the worker acts on, when the service binds authorization.

name: Permission
meaning: The permission that the worker's service account needs on each resource that the worker reads or writes. When authorization is bound, it is required.

name: Fill
meaning: The one fill that carries out the worker at the worker slot.

name: Effects
meaning: The effects the fill may stage through its worker handle, each as an outbox destination and an effect name, as for a command (ST-DECL-EN18). The destination is one that a component declares or that another worker consumes, and never authz, audit or the destination that the worker consumes itself.

name: Single
meaning: For a worker with an every trigger only. yes: one instance of the service runs the worker at a time, under a stored lease with a fencing token; no: each instance runs it. yes when it is omitted. A worker that consumes a destination omits it, because the outbox already gives each message to one instance under a lease.

name: Lease TTL
meaning: For a single worker only: how long its lease holds before another instance may take it, from 15s to 5m; 15s when it is omitted.

name: Process method name
meaning: The name, in lower kebab case and unique among the commands, queries, workers, controllers and process methods of the declaration.

name: Process
meaning: The name of the process, in the processes of the grpc-processes component, that serves the method.

name: Method
meaning: The unary protobuf method, as package.Service/Method, in a proto file of that process.

name: Fill
meaning: The one fill that carries out the method at the process method slot.

name: Resource type
meaning: The type in the authorization schema of the service-level resource that Provision and Retire are decided on, whose ID is the service name, such as service:todo-svc; never a tenant.

name: Provision permission
meaning: The permission that a principal needs on that resource to provision a tenant. When authorization is bound, it is required.

name: Retire permission
meaning: The permission that a principal needs on that resource to retire a tenant. When authorization is bound, it is required.

name: Component
meaning: The component's name.

name: Digest
meaning: The component digest whose standing this is.

name: Successor digest
meaning: The digest that replaces this one. The platform engineer declares it. Kept under database_specific in the advisory.

name: Fails after
meaning: The date after which a pin to the superseded digest fails. Kept under database_specific in the advisory.

name: Needs declaration change
meaning: Whether taking the successor needs a change to the service declaration. Kept under database_specific in the advisory.

name: Needs fill change
meaning: Whether taking the successor needs a change to a fill. Kept under database_specific in the advisory.

name: Recorded on
meaning: The date and time the platform engineer recorded the supersession.

name: Advisory id
meaning: The OSV id of the advisory, unique in the registry.

name: Summary
meaning: The OSV summary: what the successor changes, in one line, for the people who pin the digest.
example: rest-api 1.6.0 supersedes 1.5.2; the request log drops the trace id.

name: Affected
meaning: The OSV affected entry: the component, runtime library or declaration as the package, with the superseded digest or version as the introduced range and the successor as the fixed range.

name: Withdrawn
meaning: The OSV withdrawn timestamp: the date and time the advisory itself was withdrawn, when a platform engineer retracts the supersession.

name: References
meaning: The OSV references: each link to the change, its review or its release notes.

name: Fails after
meaning: The date after which a pin to the withdrawn digest fails. Kept under database_specific in the advisory.

name: Reason
meaning: Why the digest is withdrawn, for the people who pin it. It is the OSV summary of the advisory.
example: The token check accepts an expired token.

name: Recorded on
meaning: The date and time the platform engineer recorded the withdrawal.

name: Advisory id
meaning: The OSV id of the advisory, unique in the registry.

name: Affected
meaning: The OSV affected entry: the component, runtime library or declaration as the package, with the withdrawn digest or version as the affected version and no fixed range.

name: Withdrawn
meaning: The OSV withdrawn timestamp: the date and time the digest was withdrawn, which is the time the withdrawal was recorded.

name: References
meaning: The OSV references: each link to the finding that caused the withdrawal.

name: Source revision
meaning: The exact commit the release is built from.

name: Release tag
meaning: The tag of the published release.

name: Checks run
meaning: The CI run of the compiler checks at the source revision.

name: Signed artifact run
meaning: The CI run that built and signed the compiler at the source revision.

name: Immutable
meaning: Whether the published release can no longer change.

name: Compiler digest
meaning: The digest of the published compiler binary.

name: Workflow
meaning: The CI workflow the job ran in.

name: Job
meaning: The job's name.

name: Conclusion
meaning: How the job ended. Only success qualifies.

name: Name
meaning: The asset's name.

name: Size
meaning: The asset's size in bytes.

name: Digest
meaning: The digest the release publishes for the asset.

name: Result folder
meaning: The new folder that holds the installed compiler.

name: Source revision
meaning: The commit of the release that was installed.

name: Platform
meaning: The platform the release is qualified for, as its signed record states it.

name: Build identity
meaning: The build identity of the installed compiler.

name: Service name
meaning: The service the requirements belong to.

name: Schema version
meaning: The version of the requirements format.

name: Generation record digest
meaning: The digest of the generation record the file was written with.

name: Kind
meaning: What sort of thing it is.

name: Name
meaning: The name the service reads it by.

name: Shape
meaning: What a value must hold, such as a secret's keys or an endpoint's port.

name: Needed by
meaning: The component that needs it.

name: Provider
meaning: The CI system.

name: Pipeline
meaning: The platform's reusable workflow, or the Konflux standard pipeline bundle.

name: STEGO checks
meaning: The pinned bundle or action that runs every STEGO check.

name: Trusted signer
meaning: The one identity that may sign this pipeline's images.

name: Image targets
meaning: The images the pipeline builds, one per target; the delivery stanza declares them.

name: Service name
meaning: The service.

name: Image name
meaning: The image repository, with no tag or digest; the overlay sets the digest.

name: Resource defaults
meaning: The default CPU, memory and ephemeral storage requests and limits.

name: Tool
meaning: The GitOps tool; only argocd for now.

name: Project
meaning: The Argo CD project the delivery stanza names.

name: Base path
meaning: The path to the service's Kubernetes base.

name: Source revision
meaning: The commit built.

name: Image digest
meaning: The image's digest.

name: Build record digest
meaning: The stego build record the image's executable must match.

name: Provider
meaning: The CI system that built the image.

name: Check
meaning: One of drift, vet, test, build, executable match.

name: Passed
meaning: Whether the check passed.

name: Name
meaning: The fill's name, which is also its folder under fills/.

name: Implements
meaning: The one slot whose contract the fill implements.

name: Collection
meaning: The collection the fill serves.

name: Fill digest
meaning: The fill's content digest when its tests passed.

name: Contract digest
meaning: The digest of the slot contract the tests ran against.

name: Passed at
meaning: When the tests passed.

name: Compiler build
meaning: The compiler that ran the tests.

name: Evidence digest
meaning: The digest of the test evidence the signature covers.

name: Signature
meaning: The person's signature of that evidence.

name: Signed at
meaning: When the person signed.

name: Service name
meaning: The service the record describes. STEGO does not write it yet.

name: Format version
meaning: The version of the record's format. A documented field changes only with this version.

name: Declaration digest
meaning: The digest of the service declaration that apply read.

name: Registry reference
meaning: The registry reference from .stego/config.yaml.

name: Registry content digest
meaning: The digest of the registry content that apply read. A legacy record can leave it out.

name: Compiler build
meaning: The build identity of the compiler that ran the apply. A legacy record can leave it out.

name: Output folder
meaning: The folder, in the project, that holds the generated files.

name: Standing overrides
meaning: Each pin the author allowed although it was withdrawn or past its fail date, by component and digest, with the reason given.
example: outbox@sha256:4f1c…: fix 2.3.1 breaks our fill, moving next sprint

name: Defaults left
meaning: Each default the declaration leaves, tenancy kind single, audit off or a default concern of the archetype it opts out of, with the reason the declaration gives, so a fleet sweep can show it without the declaration.
example: audit off: the service holds no personal data

name: Public operations
meaning: Each operation the declaration states public, with the reason the declaration gives, so a fleet sweep can show it without the declaration.
example: catalog.list: the catalog is public by design

name: Component
meaning: The component's name.

name: Version
meaning: The component's version.

name: Digest
meaning: The digest of the component's own content. Today this column holds the registry reference, not a real per-component digest.

name: Path
meaning: The file's path in the output folder.

name: Hash
meaning: The digest of the content apply wrote.

name: Path
meaning: The file's path in the project.

name: Exists
meaning: Whether the file existed when apply read it.

name: Hash
meaning: The digest of the file's content, when it exists.

name: Mode
meaning: The file's permission bits, when it exists.

name: Output folder
meaning: The output folder the apply writes to.

name: Expected files
meaning: The state each file must have before the apply writes it.

name: Operations
meaning: Each file write in order, with the file's state before and after it.

name: Base record digest
meaning: The digest of the record the plan was made against. A plan for a service with no record leaves it out.

name: Declaration digest
meaning: The digest of the declaration that planning read.

name: Registry content digest
meaning: The digest of the registry content that planning read.

name: Compiler build
meaning: The build identity of the compiler that made the plan.

name: Output folder
meaning: The folder, in the project, that the plan writes to.

name: Planned files
meaning: Each file the plan would create, update or delete, with the hash of its new content.

name: Content digest
meaning: The digest of every input file of the active registry, which pins its content as a whole.

name: Alpha window
meaning: The months from a version's release to the fail date of the digest it supersedes, when the component's stage is alpha: the digest fails at the release.

name: Beta window
meaning: The months from a version's release to the fail date of the digest it supersedes, when the component's stage is beta.

name: Ga window
meaning: The months from a version's release to the fail date of the digest it supersedes, when the component's stage is ga.

name: Accepted declaration versions
meaning: The declaration versions the registry accepts. A breaking compiler release supersedes an old version through the registry's advisories, with a fail date, so the fleet sweep and plan's refusal carry it as they carry a component digest.

name: Path
meaning: The output path, from the generated project root.

name: Archetype name
meaning: The archetype's name, unique in its registry.

name: Version
meaning: The version the archetype declares.

name: Go SDK
meaning: The official Go SDK that every service of this archetype builds with.

name: Runtime library
meaning: The runtime library version every service of this archetype imports.

name: Default concerns
meaning: The components every service of the archetype carries unless the declaration opts out of one with a reason. A ga archetype names tenancy and audit-log.

name: Modes
meaning: The named component sets a service of the archetype can run from its one binary, each selected by the mode flag.

name: Component name
meaning: The component the archetype includes, by its name in the active registry.

name: Default for port
meaning: The port this component answers unless the declaration overrides it.

name: Mixin name
meaning: The mixin's name.

name: Requires
meaning: The mixins this one needs. Checking refuses a declaration that binds the mixin without each of them.

name: Port name
meaning: The port's name, unique in its registry.

name: Meaning
meaning: What a provider of this port undertakes to supply.
example: A verified identity for each request

name: Conformance tests
meaning: The path to the conformance test suite every provider of the port runs. A provider that has not passed it at its current digest does not graduate to ga.

name: Correctness tests
meaning: The names of the tests that prove a correctness property of the port as a whole, such as the new-enemy test of authz-decision. Its conformance suite must include each one.

name: Field name
meaning: The field a provider fills.

name: Required meaning
meaning: What every provider must put in the field.
example: The verified subject, which never changes

name: Slot name
meaning: The slot's name, unique in its component.

name: Component name
meaning: The component that declares the slot, by its name in the active registry.

name: Contract
meaning: The typed contract a fill implements, as a protobuf service.

name: Component name
meaning: The component's name, unique in the active registry.

name: Version
meaning: The version the component declares. It changes whenever the emitted code changes.

name: Stage
meaning: How far the component is on the maturity ladder.

name: Sunset
meaning: The date an alpha or beta component stops working. A ga component has none.

name: Config schema
meaning: Each setting a declaration may give the component, with its type, its allowed values, its default and whether it is optional.

name: Required ports
meaning: The ports the component needs another component to provide.

name: Provided ports
meaning: The ports the component provides.

name: Architecture role
meaning: Where the component sits in a service: its layer (edge, authentication, handler, slot, repository, store or outbound), the part it plays in a request flow, and which side of that flow each port it provides or requires is on. The architecture view places the component from this alone.
example: layer: edge; flow: receives the request and calls the handler port

name: Outcome served
meaning: The business outcome the component exists for, by its ID, stated when the component is requested and before its generator is written.

name: Minimum Go version
meaning: The lowest Go version the component's emitted code and pinned dependencies build with; the build target must meet it.

name: Runtime provider
meaning: The runtime library package that holds the provider of each port the component provides, when the provider is the same for every service and the component emits only what varies.

name: Fencing check
meaning: Whether the provider behind this component refuses a write that carries a fencing token lower than the lease holds. Without it, a controller on this provider runs one replica and never takes over an expired lease (ST-SUP-INV20).

name: Hands work to
meaning: The components, each with a lowest version, that take over work this version no longer does, such as the routes and tasks of a factory. The registry does not load this version while one of them is missing at that version or later.

name: Location
meaning: Where the registry is: a pinned Git repository or a local folder.

name: Reference
meaning: The exact commit that pins the registry content.

name: Subfolder
meaning: The folder in the repository that holds the registry, when it is not the root.

name: Trust
meaning: Whether the source is the reviewed common registry or a local extension.

name: Component name
meaning: The component the evidence is for.

name: Component digest
meaning: The exact digest the evidence was made at.

name: Kind
meaning: Which part of the bar it shows.

name: Reviewer
meaning: Who made the review or ran the benchmark.

name: Result
meaning: What it found: a review's conclusion; for a benchmark, the comparison of its figures with the figures recorded at the previous version, naming each figure that regressed; for a reference comparison, the verdict on each promise.
example: No figure regressed against 2.3.0; p99 latency improved 4%

name: Reference
meaning: Where the full review or benchmark report is kept.

name: Recorded at
meaning: When the evidence was recorded.

name: Contract set digest
meaning: For a reference comparison, the digest of the component's output contracts it was made against; the comparison is stale once they change.

name: References
meaning: For a reference comparison, each best-in-field implementation compared with, by name and version; or none, with the reasoning why no reference exists.

name: Reference
meaning: The reference that makes the promise.

name: Promise
meaning: What the reference guarantees, in one sentence.
example: Every query is type-checked against the schema at generation time.

name: Verdict
meaning: adopted or declined.

name: Contract
meaning: The component's output contract that adopts it, when adopted.

name: Reason
meaning: Why it is declined, when declined.
example: Applies to a query language STEGO does not emit.

name: Reference name
meaning: The best-in-field reference the figure was measured against, by name and version.

name: Metric
meaning: What was measured.

name: Value
meaning: The figure measured for the component.

name: Unit
meaning: The unit of the value.

name: Better direction
meaning: lower or higher: which way a change in the value is an improvement, so a comparison can tell a regression from a gain.
